semiconductor_relevance: Low — Germany Trade & Invest primarily focuses on economic development and investment support rather than semiconductor manufacturing or technology.
summary: Germany Trade & Invest (GTAI) is the economic development agency of the Federal Republic of Germany, assisting foreign businesses in understanding investment opportunities in Germany. They provide free consultations and support for market entry strategies, industry-specific data, and information on the legal and financial frameworks relevant to investors.
capabilities: Providing industry-specific market data and statistics
Information on German tax and legal frameworks
Support in finding business locations in Germany

regional_presence.Germany: GTAI operates with two locations in Germany and 58 offices abroad, promoting Germany as a business location.
